tei:div.tei:p: o rgyan smin grol gling gi srol ltar brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'dod don lhun grub kyi bca' gshom dang 'don 'grigs zin bris bcas bzhugs so// bca' gshom rnams gzhung gsal ltar la ston pa'i sku dar dmar ram ser po'i na bza' can bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du g.yon na brtsam ste chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas phreng tshar du bsham/ lte bar khri stegs khar yon bdag gi 'dra glud kyi lte bar e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ bzhi po dbu can bris pa dang*/ gnas so sor zho sha/ dung*/ bse/ mtshal/ zer mo/ mu tig /lung thang*/ mgron bu/ dar dmar/ dbang lag /lcags zangs rnams bcug /shing byang rgyab 'dod gsol skabs gang dgos so sor bsgyur/ bdud bzhi'i rgyab tu rang mdog dang mthun pa'i mda' dar bzhi 'dzugs/ sher snying gzungs dang rten snying gi gzungs zhugs can sātstsha bcu dri bzang gis sbyar ba'i rab gnas 'thor nas nye char bkod/ gzhan gzhung bstan ltar las snon 'phri med/ dngos gzhi'i thog mar smra bsam brjod med sogs dang*/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i sogs nas/ mngon par bstod do/bar tshar gcig mthar/ chos spyod las 'byung ba ltar skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi yan grub nas/ gzhung gi oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs lhug /sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes rdor dril bcas bsdu rgya/ thal sbyar bcas/ mgon po thugs rje sogs yo gdangs lhug gnyis gang bde/ pad med rang rgya bcas/ arghaṃ sogs rol sil/ rang rgya bcas dzaḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ bskor bar gyur/par bzlas pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sogs rdor gsor dang bzhi dril bcas chos spyod/ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bar yo gdangs lhug gnyis gang bde mjug rol sil/ pad med rang rgyas arghaṃ sogs rol sil/ yo ga bzhi dril bcas/ bstod par 'os pa sogs nas/ mthar nam mkha'i lha tshogs sogs nas/ thim par gyur bar/ rten snying nyer gcig bzlas te sātstsha la me tog 'thor/

mthar/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ sogs nas/ yang dag pa rnams so/ bar/ de nas zhwa bcas/ ye dhar dang dril bsil sngon 'gros rang gdangs gang bde bzhi dril bcas/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ mjug rol sil/ zhwa phud pad med rang rgya bcas/ arghaṃ sogs rol sil/ bzhi dril dang yo gdangs bcas/ bstod par 'os pa sogs dril bzhag /lhug gi ji snyed su dag sogs nas/ chen por bsngo bar/ sngags drug phyag drug skabs pad med rang rgya bcas so so'i sngags tshar gsum re dang gyur zhes phyag rgya bkrol te se gol bya/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs lhug 'don/ skabs 'dir gser skyems 'don na rang rol bcas 'don rjes zol 'jug dang*/ gser skyems ma 'don na thang zil mthar sbraṃ sbraṃ thang 12 34 56 789 thang sbraṃ thang sbraṃ thang zad dang rtse phran gyis/ kye/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /bden pa'i mchog ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'// sbraṃ 12 sogs rol/ gdangs gong ltar gyi bka' la nyon/ bar/ de nas bzlog rol chung ba gnyis brtsegs kyis/ kye/ srid gsum 'di na sogs nas/ phyag sor bzhi yi rtse la bzhugs/ sbraṃ sogs bzlog chung rol dang zil 'bebs 'og sngags sogs/ mthar bzlog chung rol gyis/ kye/ sngon tshe rgyal ba sogs nas/ srid zhi'i mgron dang ldan gyur cig /sbraṃ sbraṃ 12 34 56 789 sbraṃ sbraṃ gyis bzhag /de nas kha 'bar ma'i sngags/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ gis bsngo zhing*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/sa phrin las gsol/ gter chen zin bris las de ltar mi 'byung yang zhal khrid las byung ba ltar bkod pa lags/ mchan/ gong du gser skyems ma grub na 'dir btang*/

de nas mgo rol med pas/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni sogs nas/ rlung lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ a pa ra tsakra sogs sbraṃ bzlog chung gis bzhag zil med/ skabs so sor gzhung gsal ltar gser skyems 'bul zhing nas nag gis brab/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas/ ldan par gyur bar/ mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags phyag rgya bcas lan gsum/ 'go rol med pas/ hūm̐/ srid gsum 'di na sogs nas/ skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su dengs// bar btang bzlog chung gis bzhag zil med/ thal sbyar me tog bcas/ na mo/ brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin rgya chen po sogs sman gdangs*/ thob par gyur cig mthar me tog 'thor/ 'go rol med pas/ kye/ mchod sbyin brgya bzhi'i sogs nas/ chag che nyam nga thams cad brgya bzhis zlog /bar rol/ bzlog chung gis/ kyai/ mtho ba sogs nas/ 'di yan grangs bsags/ tshar rjes ma'i bzlog pa gzhung gsal ltar thal rdeb bya/ de min grangs bsags tshad med/ skabs 'dir grangs rdzogs nye ba'am yang na tshogs kyi mchod g.yog pas mthong brgyud bzhin nang nas sgo bar rim pas/ dang po glud gtor rnams snod gcig /phung bdud dang sātstsha snod gcig /'chi bdud dang lan chags snod gcig /nyon bdud dang mar me snod gcig /lha bdud dang zhal zas snod gcig /de dag gi mdun gser skyems bcas bsham/ tshar rjes ma'i bzlog rol chung bas sam tshogs grol ba yin na thang gsum zil dang bzlog chung gis/ hūm̐/ nyon cig ma lus bgegs sogs nas/ dam tshig las ni ma 'da' zhig /bar bzlog chung rol mthar zil bzhag /de nas rang rol dbyangs bcas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad sogs kyis gsair skyems btang*/ yas glud rnams nad pa sogs pho la g.yas dang mo la g.yon du bskor la/ bzlog chung rol gyis/ hūm̐/ bgegs kyi rgyal po sogs nas/ gnas su dengs/ bar/ bzlog chung rol mthar sbrel te drag brdung gis/ gang zhig mtshan mor sogs/

de'i dus/ lha bdud dang zhal zas shar/ nyon bdud dang mar me nub/ 'chi bdud dang lan chags lho/ phung bdud dang sātstsha byang du 'phen/ glud gtor yas lam dang bdud gcod sogs phyogs gang gnod du phul/ mjug drag brdung zil 'bebs dang che mchog padma rgyab ste zil bzhag /de nas gzhung gsal shes rab snying po'i gzungs sngags brgya stong mthar thang 1 sbraṃ sbraṃ byas 12 sogs drag brdung gis mtshams gcod gang 'os 'don/ mjug drag brdung zil bzhag /sātstsha bcu re re bzhin rten snying nyer gcig bzlas te/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs sngags bcas kyis brtan par bzhugs te gdangs lhug gang bdes/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ mthar rol sil/ sātstsha khang pa'i phyogs rnams su gzhung gsal ltar 'jog /bar 'dir 'ga' zhig gis bdud bzhi'i gzugs rgyab kyi mda' dar bzhi po thogs te tshe 'gugs bya srol snang ba ltar byas kyang legs/ ma byas kyang gzhung don chad skyon du 'gro ba ma yin 'dir mdzad srol byed ces gsung*/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos te/ pad gcig rang rgya se gol bcas/ arghaṃ sogs rol sil/ rdo dril bcas yang dag rtsa gdangs kyis/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sogs bzhi dril mjug rol sil bcas kyis grub/ phyag gi rdul tshon bsdus te khang steng lta bur gtsang sar gshegs te las kyi rjes bsdu/ de ltar brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'dod don lhun grub kyi 'don 'grigs zin bris 'di ni rnam 'dren rdor 'dzin rin po che dang tshogs chen byang 'dren pa 'jam dpal tshul khrims zung gis zhal khrid ji ltar stsal ba rnams rang gi dran gsos su yi ger btab pa'o/ bdag bskyed kyi cho ga gzhan dang sbrel nas btang tshul ni gter chen nyid kyi zin bris ltar shes par bya'o/// /
